source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of the reactions of carbonyl compounds (PDF 104).

blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones ke ahem reactions C=O group par nucleophilic addition hain (topic 23.3.1): hydrogen cyanide ka addition, hydride ions ka addition (reduction) aur 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine ke saath addition-elimination. Topic 23.3.2 phir woh tests bayan karta hai jo aldehydes aur ketones ko alag pehchante hain.

blocks.prompt: Nucleophile carbonyl compound ke kis hisse par hamla karta hai?

items: Reactions: HCN addition, hydride se reduction, 2,4-DNPH ke saath condensation; phir tests.
